ThingDef.label: office desk
ThingDef.description: A desk with a filing cabinet. Administrators work through bureaucracy projects here. Put it in a staff-only office.

WorkTypeDef.description: Work through bureaucracy projects at office desks.

RimPrison.StaffRoleDef.label: administrator
RimPrison.StaffRoleDef.description: Works through bureaucracy projects at an office desk: new departments, contracts and security clearances. Smarter administrators (Intellectual) work faster.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: foreman
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: A foreman to run prison industries: inmates press licence plates for export in the workshop and wash uniforms in the laundry.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: commissary contract
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: A supplier contract for the commissary: inmates spend their wages on treats, the prison keeps the margin.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: visitation office
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Family visits and payphones: inmates keep in touch with home (and some visitors smuggle).

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: reform programs
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: A counsellor and a classroom: education and rehab lower reoffending and tension.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: prison library
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Book shelves, a book budget and a book cart: a trusted inmate leaves books at the cells, inmates who read keep their literacy up, and the education programs pass more of them.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: security chief
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: A security chief: CCTV cameras and metal detectors.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: tasers
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Guards carry tasers: restraining an inmate succeeds far more often.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: riot gear
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Flak vests and helmets for every guard, armed guard and dog handler.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: K9 unit
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Dog handlers and their dogs: drug detection, tunnel detection, and a deterrent with teeth.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: phone monitoring
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Listen in on payphone calls: arranged handovers flag the next visit for a thorough search, and loose talk about stashes, tunnels and gangs becomes intel.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: maximum security clearance
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: The state will send maximum security inmates: violent, well paid, trouble.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: supermax clearance
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: The legal basis to hold the worst inmates in total isolation: a supermax wing with its own shower and yard. Staff killers, convicted murderers and hostage-takers are moved there when a cell is free.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: armed security
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Firearms licences: armed guards and guard towers.

RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.label: legal department, death row
RimPrison.BureaucracyDef.description: Lawyers and a state contract for condemned inmates: death row wing, appeals, executions.
